## 1. Salvador Osum dela Fuente (sponsor of the receipts, Def. Exh. 5)

| Fact for the record | Ask | Show |
|---|---|---|
| Cesar died on 21 June 2017 | "Your father, Cesar de la Fuente, died on 21 June 2017?" | (PSA certificate if obtained) |
| The only "Down payment" receipt is from 2005, from your side | "This receipt of 6 January 2005 says 'Down payment,' twenty thousand pesos. Who issued it? Is there any receipt from Ben Llamanzares?" | Def. Exh. 5, p. 3 |
| The first receipt is from October 2003, signed "Von dela Fuente" | "You are 'Von'? You signed this receipt in October 2003? Did any owner authorize you to sign receipts?" | Def. Exh. 5, p. 2 |
| Payments ran to February 2017, after a deed reciting "in hand paid" | "Receipt No. 0228, February 2017, says 'Full payment.' The deed of 29 September 2016 says the price was paid in hand that day. Which is true?" | Def. Exh. 5, p. 33; Exh. H |
| Monthly receipts to an "Occupant" are rent | "These receipts say 'Occupant's Name' and 'Payment for the month of.' A monthly payment by an occupant is rent?" | Def. Exh. 5 (2007, 2013 to 2014 receipts) |
| No owner was consulted | S31: "The owners never came home. Before the sale to Mrs. Balane, did your father, or you, ask any of the three owners?" | His affidavit, S31 |
| No owner signed the confirmation or the partition | "Your father alone signed the Deed of Confirmation of 28 March 2017? Did any owner sign the Partition-Subdivision Agreement?" | Exh. B pp. 5–6 (the entries). Hold the instruments and the notarial register for rebuttal |
| The 1991 power was administration only | "Your father's 1991 power was to manage, pay taxes and collect. Where in it is a power to sell?" | Hold; show only if he invokes the 1991 power |
| His 2025 letter (foundation, Rule 132 §13) | Show the letter; fix date and place; "Did you write and sign this?"; let him explain | Salvador's letter of 25 Nov 2025 |
